representation_differences.name: source_command_text
representation_differences.source: curl and httpie are shell command strings; this fixture records valid Unicode as text and surrogateescaped bytes as utf8_hex with representation utf8-surrogateescape
representation_differences.native: native command output must remain text and must not imply execution; replay must preserve command bytes without JSON lone surrogates

representation_differences.name: decoded_bodies
representation_differences.source: cleanup_request/cleanup_response copy each message; nonempty content decodes with strict=False and removes Content-Encoding, while missing or empty content leaves existing headers unchanged
representation_differences.native: native exports need an explicit decoded-versus-raw body rule; missing and empty bodies remain distinct

representation_differences.name: http_versions_and_reason
representation_differences.source: raw assembly preserves request/response HTTP versions and the response reason bytes
representation_differences.native: live native rows may not have these values; do not invent HTTP/1.1 or a status-derived reason

representation_differences.name: peer_ip_option
representation_differences.source: the finite true control can add curl --resolve from the synthetic server peername
representation_differences.native: actual peer address is unavailable in the current native snapshot; do not claim this source control is native parity

representation_differences.name: websocket_export
representation_differences.source: combined raw appends direction-prefixed payload bytes and omits type/drop/injected metadata
representation_differences.native: a native transcript must retain direction/type/drop independently when its workflow exposes those facts

representation_differences.name: chunked_trailers
representation_differences.source: raw assembly emits finite chunk framing and trailers; non-chunked trailers raise ValueError
representation_differences.native: native export should preserve the observed framing facts or report unavailable representation explicitly

representation_differences.name: content_encoding_inference
representation_differences.source: get_text gives BOMs highest priority, accepts declared ASCII, and infers declared HTML/XML/CSS encodings from in-body markers
representation_differences.native: native text commands need the demonstrated decoder behavior or an explicit unavailable result
